visual_narrative.prompt_token.description: A syntactic token produced by the deterministic prompt adapter.

visual_narrative.project.description: The identity of the bounded visual narrative project.

visual_narrative.line.description: A narrative line or scene unit.

visual_narrative.route.description: An ordered or branching route through narrative lines.
